name: Modern Luxury Upholstered King Size Platform Bed Frame
description: Modern minimalist luxury King-size upholstered platform bed frame. Features a premium low-profile wrap-around design with plush velvet/fabric upholstery in a versatile dark grey tone. Includes a comfortable padded rectangular headboard that is soft to lean against for reading or watching TV. Sturdy structural support eliminating the need for a box spring. Excellent condition, very clean and well-maintained. Perfect upgrade for a master bedroom. Selling cheap for graduation moving sale! Note: Mattress, pillows, and bedding sheets are not included.
name_zh: 现代极简软包大号双人床架 (King Size)
description_zh: 意式现代极简风 King Size（加 critical 双人床）软包落地榻榻米床架。采用高级深灰色亲肤织物/微绒面料全包裹设计，低重心防撞。配有加厚填充的舒适长方形靠背软包床头，倚靠看书看电视非常舒适。排骨架支撑结构稳固无异响，无需额外配置弹簧床盒（Box Spring）。成色极新，干净无污渍。主卧升级首选，毕业搬家超值特价转让！（注：转让仅限床架，不包含照片中的床垫、枕头及被褥）
